description: blocks-run: an effect's run native (EffectBlock.Run, 06c): KL340 for a parameter that names no binding, for a required attackMod with no damage in the effect, for a declaration that is not "sync": true and for one whose argc is not its named parameters; an optional damage and another mod's native are fine.

diagnostics.message: run fixture-blocks-run.OnHit: parameter 'attackMod' has nothing to bind to: this effect deals no damage (give it damage, or make the parameter Optional)
run fixture-blocks-run.Odd: parameter 'victim' names nothing a run native gets; its parameters are named self, target, attacker, caster, position, attackMod, damage
run fixture-blocks-run.Later: its declaration is not "sync": true; a native that answers a step later cannot run inside the effect
run fixture-blocks-run.Miscount: its declaration's argc (2) is not its 1 named parameter(s)
